cards.title: Baby's First Cold: A Parenting Milestone
cards.body: A cartoon perspective on the inevitable moment when your baby catches their first cold. A humorous take on this universal parenting experience.

cards.title: Pediatrician: Human Connection Matters More Than AI
cards.body: A pediatrician argues that loss of human connection poses a bigger threat to children than technology. The solution lies in open conversations between parents and kids, not screen restrictions.

cards.title: Making Halloween Magic With Your Kids
cards.body: A parent ditches cynicism to create meaningful Halloween traditions with their children. Celebrating autumn can be a moment of genuine connection and wonder for families.

cards.title: Partner's Behavior at Kids' Sports Events
cards.body: A parent struggles with their partner's obnoxious conduct during their sons' football matches. Advice suggests investigating the root of the anger before addressing the inappropriate behavior.

cards.title: When Your Child's Friend Wears a Tutu
cards.body: A parent witnesses their partner's kindness when he wears a tutu to entertain their younger siblings. It becomes a defining moment revealing their true character as a potential co-parent.

cards.title: Why Tantrums Happen and How to Help
cards.body: You can't stop a tantrum immediately, but you can help build the brain that learns to manage them. Lending your calm to your child is key to understanding meltdowns.

cards.title: Protecting Vulnerable Families Before Crisis
cards.body: Early identification of emerging vulnerabilities in family care can prevent reaching a state of crisis. Intervention at the right moment can reduce the number of families needing emergency support.

cards.title: Twin Identity: Learning to Be Individuals
cards.body: Twins need to learn that not everything must be shared automatically. Respecting individual identity is an important personal value for growing twins to develop.

cards.title: Fathers, Changing Values, and Estrangement
cards.body: Fathers who struggle to accept their adult children's changing beliefs and values risk deepening emotional distance. This can inadvertently lead to lasting estrangement as children establish independence.

cards.title: Great-Grandmother Becomes Kinship Carer
cards.body: A 74-year-old great-grandmother found purpose and meaning in raising her great-grandchildren after her daughter passed away. She credits becoming a kinship carer with saving her life.

cards.title: School Half-Term Lengths: A Parental Divide
cards.body: Parents are deeply divided on two-week half terms, with childcare arrangements being a major concern. Some struggle to find care while others see cheaper holiday opportunities.
